head: Unexploded ordnance & mines
sub: Unfamiliar objects may be unexploded explosives. They are dangerous even if they look old.

rules.d: Stop moving where you are. Shout to people nearby to stop too.

rules.t: Go back the way you came
rules.d: Slowly retrace your own footsteps. Don't take a new route.
Leave a visible marker nearby, never on the object. Don't cover or move it.
Tell authorities or an aid group where it is. Don't use radios or phones close to the object.

watch: Objects that look like toys or cans
Objects with wires or strings attached
extra: Be especially careful around damaged buildings, abandoned vehicles, bushes and roadsides.
Teach children never to pick up unfamiliar objects.
